title: Introducing Hark Pro | Hark
text:
Sign Up
8 MIN READ - OCT 06
Introducing Hark Pro

For the better part of the year, we’ve been building something new.

We call it Hark Pro. The operating system for your life.

Available today, for free, to everyone, Hark Pro is an iOS/Android/web app that thinks ahead of you to reduce friction across your day. It remembers what you tell it, uses its own cloud computer, and solves problems you might not realize you had.

Our goal is true personal intelligence. Not a chatbot, not a personal assistant, not an AI agent, not a cartoon character. Something that learns who you are to prioritize your well-being rather than exploiting it.

Hark can keep track of life, work, and school, and buy everything from groceries to concert tickets. It stores logins securely, pays bills, and spots opportunities you'll love.

Now let’s take a tour.

Thinking a step ahead

For the last 50 years, personal computers have reacted to what you ask of them. Build a spreadsheet. Book a car. Find pictures of kittens.

You make a call. The computer gives a response

Hark Pro is moving toward a new model, one that anticipates your needs to address them ahead of time. To both respond to what you ask and predict the next thing, too. That’s in part because Hark actually uses its own computer, which we call Handoff.

Handoff is independently verified to be the most performant computer use model in the world. Handoff juggles up to 6 browsers at the same time, and can log in to millions of different websites on your behalf, ensuring that Hark can go anywhere you can go on the web. Outside the browser, Hark connects directly to services like Google and Outlook via APIs, plus it reads files, accesses external databases, and finds information through a secure open source standard MCP.

But Hark’s computer is just one part of its advanced system.

The second piece is memory. Hark remembers what you tell it and what it learns about you (unless, of course, you ask it to forget something - which it will). Hark builds a portrait of you and your preferences. It will remember that you don’t like mayo and always choose the window seat, that you love pugs and there’s a very particular way you want your documents formatted. And then it applies this context to every interaction you have on the platform.

The third component that brings it all together is proactive thinking. Hark considers your life, and uses its own tools like Handoff, to actually solve challenges ahead before you even encounter them.

Let’s give an example. You can easily buy a movie ticket on Hark Pro, and it will find you great seats. But Hark won’t just buy you a movie ticket; it will also scope out the parking, offer to reserve you a spot at the nearest garage, and send you the QR code to enter. Hark won’t pile up all of this at once in your chat; it will pace these steps out so they arrive at just the right time.

You can always create your own scheduled tasks and reminders with Hark. But the best part about proactivity is that these suggestions are spontaneous. We’ve seen Hark spot money running out on a student’s lunch card, flagging it to be refilled before the end of the week. If you allow it, Hark can even solve some of these problems for you - like by topping off that card on its own so that no one forgets.

A casual, smart interface

While Hark Pro’s scope is vast, it feels like a straightforward messaging app. That’s by design. Hark speaks in short bursts rather than long novels, pulling up sharp charts and colorful multimedia when a few words won’t cut it. There’s no reason to bury someone in more information than they will read, and we want every turn of the conversation to feel just right.

For long-horizon thinking, we have Projects. These are dedicated chats that store files for you in their own threads. If you’re planning a big event, or tracking a single topic for work, Projects are the perfect spot.

And finally, there’s Home. This is your space you can customize as your own, where Hark sends timely information to you.

Here, you’ll see our Action Buttons. These are the evolution of notifications. Instead of bugging you with work, they solve themselves with a tap. You can “pay” a bill or “cancel” an unused subscription simply by pressing on the word itself. Language comes to life as instant utility.

Below the buttons, you can create your own Panels. These are bespoke mini apps that spin up from your imagination (and about any connected account you like). Follow your workouts on Strava, see new releases on Netflix cross referenced with their Rotten Tomato scores, or just view the latest grades landing on ParentSquare. Panels pull in your data from these services, display it, and then, even let you ask it questions.

The backdrop to all of these experiences isn’t just another white or black screen. We wanted Hark Pro to feel personal to you, for its interface to actually be a reflection of your own lived experience. Which is why we render a live simulation of the atmosphere wherever you are on Earth.

As you use Hark Pro, you will see clouds blow by, the glow of haze in the air, and even the sun rise and set with captivating gradients. Hark tracks over a dozen real-time signals, randomizing them to build this simulation so that it never repeats. It’s the second most beautiful sky you will ever see.

Secured by Hark

All of this capability means nothing with compromise. So we’ve architected Hark Pro to respect your privacy and the autonomy of your Hark data.

It starts with a system we built in-house called Secured by Hark. This is an encrypted vault for your most vital information. That includes your credit cards and passwords stored so that Hark can log in to sites for you and do things on your behalf.

Even we can’t see inside Secured by Hark. And as it fills in your password on a site, we can’t see that either. Your password is encrypted all the way from the vault to the website until the moment it lands. Just as it should be.

We also recognize some fundamentals about your privacy that drive every decision we make in the product.

Your data is yours
We will never sell it
We will never share it with advertisers
You can always delete it

Personal intelligence needs to be personal to work, but you shouldn’t have to trade your privacy for the privilege. Hark will never sell you out.

Trying Hark Pro

Hark Pro is available today. All of its features will always be available for free, because we believe the best technologies should be available to everyone.

$20/month gets you 2x more usage with Hark Pro². And $100/mo gets you 10x more usage with Hark Pro³.

We’ve been so eager to share our first product, but we recognize Hark Pro is just the beginning.

The operating system of your life will need hardware, which we’re designing now. It will need smarter models, which we’re training now. And perhaps most of all, it will need to prove its integrity, which we’re demonstrating now.

Hark is here to fork the timeline. We don’t need to settle for platforms that steal our attention or companies that rob our privacy. We need new computers that have our best interests at heart. That let us spend more time with the people we love, pursuing the things we’re most passionate about.

We hope you love using Hark Pro. And we cannot wait to share what’s next.
